strategy.overview: In Space Ship, knock down the six left targets to light their follow-up lane; completing that sequence resets the bank, scores 80,000, and lights Special, with a replay on the next cycle. Work the four progressive targets to raise Bonus X through 3x, 5x, 10x, and 20x. Complete the A-B-C-D lanes once to light Extra Ball at the yellow target, then complete them again for Special.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Space Ship, knock down the six left targets, then take their lit follow-up lane to reset the bank for 80,000 and light Special; the next completed cycle awards a replay. Hit the four progressive targets to raise Bonus X through 3x, 5x, 10x, and 20x. Complete A-B-C-D once for a lit Extra Ball, then again for Special.
strategy.summary: Build Bonus X with the progressive targets whenever their shots are under control. Use the six-target bank for the 80,000-and-Special cycle, and take A-B-C-D lanes opportunistically because their first and second completions open Extra Ball and Special.

steps.text: Hit the four progressive targets to advance Bonus X through 3x, 5x, 10x, and 20x.
Knock down all six left targets to light their follow-up lane.
Take the lit follow-up lane to finish the sequence, reset the targets, score 80,000, and light Special.
Repeat the six-target sequence for the second-cycle replay.
Complete the A-B-C-D lanes once to light Extra Ball at the fixed yellow target, then complete them again for Special.

alternatives.title: Lit-star and bumper route
alternatives.when: Use this while the ball is already circulating through the upper playfield.

steps.text: Hit pairs of the left targets to light the corresponding stars and bumpers.
Touch a lit star to make its paired bumper flash.
Hit the flashing bumper for 100,000; repeat by relighting it at the star.
Finish the progressive targets to reach 20x Bonus.
Complete A-B-C-D once for the Extra Ball collect and again for Special.
Complete two six-target cycles for the lit Special and replay sequence.

machineSetup: Confirm Bonus X behavior through 20x, balls per game, Extra Ball conversion, Special conversion, replay behavior, and score-threshold awards.
Test all six left targets, the follow-up lane, four progressive targets, A-B-C-D lanes, fixed yellow target, three pop bumpers, star switches, lower-right trapdoor, and every progress lamp.
